reports.description: Here is the background of how I am cheated by the suspects in this online BTC scam : On November 3, 2021, I was contacted on Twitter by an user name cycbercash28(@Madmarkets_) multiple duplicate twitter addresses (@Madmraket, @Madmrakete) suggesting me to invest in BTC on their website https://bittpayoptions.org saying that I would be getting 6 times returns in a short period of 6 weeks. Over the period of 6 weeks starting from Nov.4 2021 through Dec.20 2021, I bought $248,000 worth of BTC coin and sent it over to a BTC address associated to an account they had me create on their website. I also sent $10,000 worth of USDC(cryptocurrency) to the USDC address they associated to my account on their website. The current balance they are showing under my account is $1,747,906.00, saying that my account has grown in value to this through their investments. Now, when I asked them to pay my money as 6 weeks have passed, they are asking me to send another $200K worth BTC to a different BTC address. The bad actors provided me their names on WhatsApp chat as Angel and Evans. I think these are fake ID names. The WhatsApp number they have used to chat with me during this period are +1-805-554-7453 and +1-530-424-9532. When I called the first number directly, the person who lifted the call mentioned no one by name Angel resides at that address. The latter number does not lift the call but says it is a google voice subscriber. I could only once talk to the former number through WhatsApp for a couple of minutes before they hung up the call. I also grew even more suspicious when looking at the phone numbers and the addresses on their website(https://bittpayoptions.org/) because I was able to see that both of them were fake. The phone numbers listed seem to be listed on a bunch of other fake websites online and the address they listed is the address of a random factory in Luxembourg. Due to this, I asked them to send certification of their company to validate their legitimacy. The stock brokerage certificate they sent over seems to be fake as the organization that they have listed does not seem to be legitimate and you can clearly see that the original name on the certificate has been whited- out and edited. I have received e-mails from these agents with email addresses angelfxcooperation@gmail.com and Support@bittpayoptions.org to my email address. This is the latest address they want me to send another $200k worth BTC address bc1qtsng5rszsdu2hljxqprcaa3jype9q293wq9wap In order to lure me to send another $200k, they are showing that they are ready to send 1.7milion from a BTC address : 1N3PPyHfktHpmyEKYkc1rtxbUFKVxN4mSY I believe, this is a racket with this group containing the following twitter address because (@Madmrakete) pulled me into a conversation involving the other addresses namely (Tolga Kumova @KomovaTolga, T0M Dante @TheTraderDante, cybercash28 @MadMrakete, JAMES @TheJames_Joel,  The World Currency @TheWorldCurrenc )
